Name: Threading The Film
PreText: [b][color=ffffff][lb]On Use][/color][/b] Move up to 2 uses of a limited skill to another limited skill with at least 1 remaining use. If this triggers the [b][color=64aaff][lb]Exhaust][/color][/b] effect of the first skill, trigger the effect as if it was on this skill, and gain 1 [b][color=5080cc]Protection[/color][/b].
PostText: [b][color=ffffff][lb]After Use][/color][/b] Gain 1 [b][color=ffaa64]Haste[/color][/b] and regain 2 [b][color=ffff64]Stagger Resist[/color][/b] for each of your [b][color=64aaff]Exhausted[/color][/b] skills.
